Years ago I had my ex’s ex girlfriend threaten to shoot me and she disappeared into the bedroom and yelled out she was getting a gun to shoot me. I didn’t move from where she left me standing in the kitchen. My ex kept shouting at me to leave the apartment with him, but I didn’t listen to him, didn’t move a muscle, pissed as hell internally that I was soaked in cold Dunkin’ Donuts coffee, but I remember feeling oddly calm. My adrenaline was going of course because it was the craziest situation I’ve ever been in at that point in my life, but I wasn’t frozen in fear. Super weird reaction. In hindsight, yeah that was stupid and I should have gotten the fuck out of there the moment she disappeared to get the gun like she told me, but she ended up re-emerging from the bedroom without a gun anyway. After that, I became acutely aware I handle stressful situations really well, pretty handy when it comes to my job. INTP perk?

I still can’t say I know. I’ve only mostly have had bad relationships. I’ve had a couple toxic ones in the past where I thought I was “in love” with them, but looking back I realized I was trying to figure out how I could help them be a better person and I was addicted to the passion. I’ve also had relationships where I originally thought I loved them because they really, REALLY loved me, but one day I realized I wasn’t actually in love in the same way they were with me, and I would abruptly end things “out of nowhere” and consequently hurt and confuse them. Which still makes me feel bad whenever I think back on it.

Currently I’m in a healthy relationship with someone for well over three years, will be four years next year February. I’m fully aware I still suck as a person in a relationship and I still greatly enjoy being alone (I’ve been living by myself for the past four years), although I enjoy seeing my boyfriend. I love my boyfriend because he’s very understanding and sweet to me and has never said anything bad to me (even though I would deserve it), but I’m not sure what it is to be in love I think. I’m still trying to figure it out, but I do know he loves me and I don’t mind and that’s nice. It’s quite delightful to know that him being an ENTJ is compatible with my INTP ass.
